title: The `--mmseqs-max-seqs` help omits the default for static seeding
body:
`--mmseqs-max-seqs` takes its default from `--seed-mode` through two `default_value_if` calls in nail/src/args.rs: 300 for `static` and 2147483647 for `prog`. `nail search --help` shows only 2147483647, the default for `prog`, which is the default seed mode. A survey of `dev` on 2026-11-02 saw 300 in the `-s` output of a static run.

## Proposal

The help text states both defaults.
close_reason: The --mmseqs-max-seqs doc comment states both defaults and hide_default_value stops clap printing the prog one. Committed on dev.
